title: Make HTTP timeouts configurable and raise default for large requests
author: Hiro Tanaka
description: Adjust the Go SDK default HTTP client timeout from 30s to 5m and make it configurable per client. This addresses timeouts reported for large non-streaming chat requests (SUP-4888). No changes to SSE streaming path.
review_conversation: Reviewer (Grace): Please document the tradeoffs of long timeouts.
Author (Hiro): Added note on cancellation via context.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash; released in redwood-sdk-go v0.9.3
